name: Multi-Comp
purpose: Compressor with seven hardware-style modes (opto, FET, VCA, bus, studio FET, studio VCA, digital) for levelling vocals, adding punch to drums and gluing buses.

latency.note: Oversampling and lookahead add latency; the core reports it.

expose.ai_hint: Opto: smooth vocal levelling. FET: aggressive, forward vocals and drums. Bus: drum and mix glue. Studio modes: cleaner. Digital: precise. Set only the parameters of the chosen mode.

hidden_reason: Multiband mode, sidechain EQ, external sidechain, lookahead, distortion, link modes and meters stay at defaults; multiband needs its own catalogue entry.
notes: Parameters come from the DAF build's descriptor table, which drives the framework-free MultiCompDSP core Plugsalot embeds. The older JUCE layout differs (e.g. Opto gain unity point, VCA controls).
VCA attack, release, over-easy and detector are inert in the current core and are excluded.
Starting points and hints are drawn from the Dusk Audio Multi-Comp manual (manuals/multi-comp.md) and core source comments.
Each mode has its own threshold scale, so switching mode means re-setting the compression amount.
